issue.title: Show pomodoro blocks when a toggle moves a Task Link between equal-indent entries
issue.description: When a capture removes a Task Link line from one Pomodoro and inserts the same bytes under another, show both Pomodoros in `pomodoro_blocks`: the source with that line removed, the destination with it added. The case bob-cli-2r.2 hit is a two-way toggle that moves a link between entries at the same indentation, where the insert and the duplicate removal net to a pure line move.

task_type_fields.proposal: When a capture removes a Task Link line from one Pomodoro and inserts the same bytes under another, show both Pomodoros in `pomodoro_blocks`: the source with that line removed, the destination with it added. The case bob-cli-2r.2 hit is a two-way toggle that moves a link between entries at the same indentation, where the insert and the duplicate removal net to a pure line move.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: `blocks_refs` auto-detects toggles and does not plumb refs. `autodetect` in `src/native/capture/pomodoro_blocks.rs` treats a line whose bytes survive unmapped on the other side of the Myers diff as a move and skips it. `assert_pomodoro_blocks_cover_changes` documents that moves never fail the invariant, because whole-item starts relocate entries the same way and must stay exempt. The planned toggle tests cover insert, create, and open-direction removal, not this equal-indent move.

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli-2r.2 found that a two-way toggle which moves a Task Link between equal-indent Pomodoros emits no pomodoro_blocks. The epic's auto-detect ignores Myers-aligned moves and the plan gives toggles no refs, so this stays out of that epic.
